About the party

Tanya (T) / Mia (M)

- T: So, how was the party?
- M: It was marvelous and I had a blast.
- T: Did everyone go with their bells on?
- M: Most people; though, SOMEONE was just wandering out of boredom. 
- T: SOMEONE? WAIT! Mike was there?
- M: Yeap! He was asking everybody about you... if they had seen you anywhere.   
- T: No way! No one would believe that! The guy who feasts his eyes on anyone or anything?
- M: Yeah, right? I guess someone is realizing he lost his chance. 
- T:  Indeed! I will go nowhere with that dude again.

E. Write an 80 -120 word text describing the most boring experience you have ever had in your life. Who was there? Where were you? What were you doing there? What would you recommend or suggest people to do in a similar situation? Include the language studied.
